wiki_article:
**Viola Arquette Contributor License v1.0** is a revoked internal license governing a heteronymic audio-contribution position.

The license identifies Viola Arquette as a heteronymic position rather than a separate natural person. Its scope is limited to audio or musical work associated with Maybe Space Baby Garden Lanes. It defines a write-once contribution model, an attribution airlock, self-service prospective revocation, archive-scanning permissions, generous analytical treatment, and a dedicated registry.

The license attempts to preserve the separation between the heteronymic position and the person bearing it. It also limits the contributor role so that the license does not become a general grant over unrelated work.

The public title and body mark the license revoked. Revocation ends future privileges under the instrument; it does not erase already deposited artifacts or their provenance.

Several clauses combine project governance, copyright language, and archival procedure. They should not be represented as settled legal conclusions without jurisdiction-specific review.
